description: This file provides utility functions for applying and toggling Markdown formatting (bold, italic, link, strike, code, heading, quote, unordered and ordered lists) within a text message, including handling of selection ranges and markdown delimiters.

methods.name: applyMarkdown
methods.description: Main function that applies or toggles specific markdown styles based on the provided options.

methods.name: applyMarkdownToSelectedLines
methods.description: Applies markdown delimiters to entire lines within the selected range, such as list or heading markers.

methods.name: applyLinkMarkdown
methods.description: Wraps selected text with markdown link syntax or removes it if already present.

methods.name: applyCodeMarkdown
methods.description: Wraps selected text with inline code or code block delimiters depending on multiline selection.

methods.name: applyBoldItalicMarkdown
methods.description: Handles toggling of bold and italic markdown based on mode.

methods.name: getMultilineSuffix
methods.description: Extracts suffix for multiline markdown processing.

methods.name: getNewSuffix
methods.description: Extracts suffix for multiline markdown processing.

methods.name: applyOlMarkdown
methods.description: Applies or removes ordered list markdown (numbered list).

methods.name: applyMarkdownToSelection
methods.description: Wraps or removes markdown delimiters around selected text.

methods.name: findWordEnd
methods.description: Finds the end index of a word starting from a given position.

methods.name: findWordStart
methods.description: Finds the start index of a word ending at a given position.

methods.name: isSelectionMultiline
methods.description: Checks if the current selection spans multiple lines.
